title: Weekly AI Worldview | WEKA $140M; AWS $9B Singapore; Huawei Ascend Demo Clarification
summary: One week of global AI funding, events, and people moves. CN images — attach on ingest (29). Inventory type kept as ranking.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Weekly AI Worldview · May 20, 2024

One week of global AI funding, events, and people moves. CN images — attach on ingest (29). Inventory type kept as ranking.

This week’s headlines

  • Funding: Cross-dimensional Intelligence strategic round (Lenovo Capital lead); Spines $6.5M; trawa €10M seed; WEKA $140M Series E at $1.6B; Gamma $12M Series A
  • Events: Xiaohongshu “Xiao Digua” model tests; ByteDance acquires Oladance; Microsoft €4B France AI data center; OpenAI GPT-4o free; ByteDance Volcano Engine / Doubao; Tencent Hunyuan T2I open-source (DiT, Sora-class); Anthropic Europe expansion; AWS $9B Singapore; Azure GPT-4o; DeepMind Project Astra; Accel $650M Europe/Israel fund; Microsoft China AI team relocation clarification; Huawei Ascend demo clarification; xAI ~$10B Oracle server lease talks; OpenAI Startup Fund +$5M
  • People: Kai-Fu Lee / 01.AI AI 2.0; Altman on GPT-5 & open source; Ilya Sutskever exits OpenAI → Jakub Pachocki; AWS CEO Adam Selipsky exit → Matt Garman; Mike Krieger joins Anthropic as CPO; Jan Leike exits OpenAI safety

Funding

  • Cross-dimensional Intelligence (跨维智能) — strategic financing led by Lenovo Capital. Core Sim2Real tech synthesizes 3D simulation data to ease embodied-AI data scarcity; applied in industry, semiconductors, auto, PV. Funds expand R&D, deepen tech, broaden markets. (Cross-dimensional Intelligence)
  • Spines (Israel AI publishing) — $6.5M seed led by Aleph. One-stop AI cover design, proofreading, audiobook production; authors can publish in two weeks with up to 30% cost savings. CEO Yehuda Niv: a tech-led publishing revolution for self-publishing. (Spines)
  • trawa (Berlin renewable energy) — €10M seed; total raised >€12M; Balderton Capital lead. AI energy-procurement for SMEs: optimized energy mix, up to 30% cost cut, real-time monitoring & cost tools; multi-supplier traceability / green attributes; ESG fit. (trawa)
  • WEKA — $140M Series E led by Valor Equity Partners; NVIDIA, Generation Investment Management, Atreides Management join. Valuation nearly doubles to $1.6B. Founded 2013 by Liran Zvibel, Maor Ben-Dayan, Omri Palmon; AI-native data platform optimized for GPU / AI / HPC workloads — speed, usability, scale, sustainability. (WEKA)
  • Gamma — $12M Series A led by Accel. Generates professional PPT, web pages, docs; already profitable in B2B; user-created pages surpass 60M. Real-time collaboration; Accel likens it to Canva’s democratization of design — for B2B. (Gamma)

Events

  • Xiaohongshu “Xiao Digua” (小地瓜) — internal testing of self-developed large model led by AI innovation head Zhang Debing; multimodal content & creation tools (AI doodle / image pairing already shipped). Prior: model-optimized search/recommendation, “DAVINCI” search assistant, “AI pet companion.” AI as depth support for existing apps + future scenes. (Xiaohongshu)
  • ByteDance × Oladance — March acquisition of OWS / Oladance brand Dashiw Tech for roughly ¥300–500M. Open-wear stereo (OWS) tech; ex-Bose team. Path: AI earbuds first, then combine Oladance audio with PICO AR-glasses experience toward Meta Ray-Ban-like smart glasses, then AR. (ByteDance)
  • Microsoft €4B France — AI data center in Mulhouse, eastern France — Microsoft’s largest France bet; President Brad Smith cites confidence in France as European tech leader and low-carbon energy for green strategy. (Microsoft)
  • OpenAI GPT-4o — multimodal text/audio/image; response as fast as 232 ms; ChatGPT Plus features (vision, browsing, etc.) free to the public. End-to-end design said to beat Whisper-V3 and leading Google/Meta speech; vision above Gemini 1.0 Ultra and Claude Opus. (OpenAI)
  • ByteDance Volcano Engine FORCE Spring 2024 (May 15) — first public show of self-developed model family; major “Volcano Ark” platform update. Domestic large models >200; Cyberspace Administration generative-AI filing count to 117. (Volcano Engine)
  • Tencent Hunyuan T2I open-source (May 14) — first Chinese-native DiT-architecture open model (same class as Sora); CN/EN input; 1.5B params; full resources on Hugging Face & GitHub; free commercial use. (Tencent)
  • Anthropic Europe expansion — new financing amid OpenAI GPT releases; deepen R&D and market reach. (Anthropic)
  • AWS $9B Singapore (4 years) — doubles AWS’s Singapore total investment; part of ~$35B non-U.S. investments this year spanning Japan, Saudi Arabia, Mexico, Singapore. (Amazon)
  • Azure GPT-4o — text/image open now (video/audio later); personalized teaching, real-time translation demos; more at Build 2024. (Microsoft)
  • DeepMind Project Astra (Google I/O 2024) — multimodal real-time agent (text/audio/video) via phone or Google glasses; scenes incl. navigation for the blind; some metrics below GPT-4o; coming to Android/iOS TBD. (Google)
  • ByteDance Doubao model family + Volcano Engine 2.0 — role-play, speech, T2I, etc.; Jetour co-built smart CS “AI Xiao Jie”; veOmniverse and hybrid-cloud veStack intelligent-compute edition. (FORCE)
  • Accel $650M new Europe & Israel fund — 8th regional fund since London 2000; seed–Series A; >200 prior investments incl. Supercell, Spotify; focus cyber, intelligent business, AI. Europe VC Q1 mild rebound to €16.3B. (Accel)
  • Microsoft China AI team relocation rumor — company: international rotation option for a minority of employees, not whole-team move; voluntary; prior reports cited hundreds deciding by June 7 and family visa help. (Microsoft)
  • Huawei Ascend community demo clarification — at Kunpeng Ascend Developer Conference: mxRAG SDK demo was live, not pre-loaded images; time.sleep(6) waits for external open-source model return; code to be shown publicly. (Ascend Community)
  • xAI × Oracle — talks on ~$10B long-term AI server lease; xAI completing $6B raise for cloud/GPU spend. Musk: scale toward 100k NVIDIA H100 for Grok 3.0 (Grok 2.0 trains on 20k H100); target by H2 2025. (The Information)
  • OpenAI Startup Fund +$5M — control transfer: Ian Hathaway succeeds Sam Altman; third SPV; fund NAV to $325M this year; Microsoft and others as external partners; legal, medical, robotics, etc. (OpenAI Startup Fund)

People

  • Kai-Fu Lee / 01.AI anniversary — AI 2.0 dual-track model strategy; exit “bike-share-style subsidies”; Yi-Large + Yi-1.5 upgrades; call for cost discipline. Overseas ToC “Wanzhi” on membership; after China shakeout, apps from entertainment to productivity. (01.AI)
  • Sam Altman — GPT-5 via novel release path; unprecedented open-source intent; at high intelligence, less dependence on huge datasets; supply chain & energy challenges but global solutions given AI’s social value; All-in Podcast. (All-in Podcast)
  • Ilya Sutskever exits OpenAI after 8 years as chief scientist; tied to prior board conflict; publicly apologized and co-signed call to restore Altman/Brockman; title retained but off day-to-day; new “meaningful” project TBD. Successor: Jakub Pachocki (at OpenAI since 2017). (OpenAI)
  • AWS CEO Adam Selipsky exits next month after 14 years (also ex-Tableau CEO); Matt Garman (SVP) takes over in June; deepen generative AI commitment. (AWS)
  • Mike Krieger (Instagram co-founder) joins Anthropic as CPO for Claude — consumer + enterprise, new mobile apps and enterprise solutions. CEO Dario Amodei: product/UX strength for workplace interaction. (Anthropic)
  • Jan Leike exits OpenAI safety (May 18) after Sutskever; criticized insufficient safety focus; wants more product safety & adversarial robustness spend; Altman plans piece on safety strategy; “departure agreements” rumors. (NYT)

— END —
